items.title: Why Boeing Through ETFs Could Make Sense After Its New Jet Order
items.summary: You might like Boeing and still hesitate to own only that single stock. Simply Wall St flags that its debt is not well covered by operating cash flow, so holding just Boeing means your money leans heavily on that one issue. Owning it through a fund that also holds other businesses reduces how much Boeing specific risks can move your portfolio, and trims how much its success alone can lift your returns.
